card.name: Linking words after web-page nouns
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as "and", "or", "of" and "to" right after a plain noun or verb in website or usage-terms text. The word that follows is a further verb or noun in the list.

modes.label: and/or after a verb or noun
modes.description: "and" or "or" joining actions or items in web-use instructions.
modes.example: - download<< and>> retain copies of the Material on their personal

modes.label: of/to after a noun
modes.description: "of" or "to" following a noun like nature or link in site notices.
modes.example: Let us know the nature<< of>> the problem, the Web address of what

card.plain: It fires on little joining words in website notices and usage terms, right where a list or next phrase continues.
